snippet.title: Sega Saturn - Jikkyou Powerful Pro Yakyuu '95 (1995)
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
Jikkyou Powerful Pro Yakyuu '95 is a Sports game, developed and published by Konami, which was released in Japan in 1995.
